title: Federal Judge Denies Gemini and CFTC Bid to Erase 2025 Settlement
snippet: A federal judge refused to overturn a $5 million settlement that cryptocurrency exchange Gemini reached with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission in January 2025 and has already paid, CoinDesk reported Friday (Oct. 16).
